trace_origin: original_native_pose for local capture; synthetic_native_sample only for CPU diagnostics
context_review: Reviewer must bind the actual intersection boundary, each highway origin, governing official device and operability, approach opposition, and left-turn action or intent to original source references. All camera byte hashes must match the context review.
measurement: Derive occupancy from the retained original x/y trace and reviewed intersection bounds. Entry is the first outside-to-inside frame for each vehicle. Report priority occupancy at ego entry, simultaneous occupancy, and ego speed during the entry interval. Keep exclusion context separate from any legal verdict.
limits: This contract and its diagnostic proof do not establish route feasibility, physical compliance, accepted equivalence, or original recording coverage.
